newsitem.title: USA: April, May paper Brent firms in late U.S. trading.
newsitem.headline: April, May paper Brent firms in late U.S. trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent gained ground in late U.S. paper trading on Tuesday, but volumes were thin for both April and May dealings, traders said.
A total of 100 lots of paper Brent moved in April at $19.54, 4 cents higher than the IPE settlement price.
A further 50 lots sold in April Brent at $19.57, and again for 50 lots more at $19.60, traders said.
All of the partial strips of Brent paper were dealt to a Wall Street broker, traders said.
May Brent attracted a deal for 100 lots at $19.19, 4 cts above the May IPE settlement price.
Traders said a pair of inter-month spreads moved, both sold by a U.K. major for the April/May spread at +35 cts.
